correctness.rationale: The summand H(k) has exactly one term 1/2^L of least 2-adic valuation, L=floor(log_2 k), hence ν₂(H(k))=-L and ν₂(1/(kH(k)))=L-ν₂(k)≥0, equality only for k a power of two. For odd a, ell=floor(log₂ a), W_t=2^(ell+t)H(2^t a) is a 2-adic unit and W_(t+1)-W_t=2^(ell+t+1)Σ_(odd u≤2^(t+1)a)1/u. Inverting yields ν₂(q_(t+1)-q_t)≥2ell+t+1; the exact odd-part block decomposition gives ν₂(Δ_(r+1)-Δ_r)≥r. Completeness produces the unique odd C=lim Δ_r and D=lim(G(2^r)-rC), with errors divisible by 2^r and 2^(r+1) respectively. Independent exact fraction residues for r=3..9 were [94,207,64,177,34,147,4] mod 256, giving C=113 and D=11 mod 256, and all-scale G(2^r)≡113r+11 mod256 for r≥3. Parity follows from powers-of-two terms. These infinite statements are proved by the lifting identity, not checked by the finite residue experiment.
